summary: GLM responses keep the whitespace the model generated in reasoning and before tool calls, so the next turn can reuse the cached response
compatibility: With the glm45/glm47 parsers, reasoning can now end in the newline the model generated, content before tool calls keeps its surrounding whitespace, and whitespace-only content before a tool call is returned instead of null. Nothing changes when the model generates no whitespace there. Other parsers are unchanged.
details: A follow-up request reuses a hybrid model's response checkpoint only when the returned assistant message re-renders to the tokens the model generated. The parser trimmed reasoning, stripped content before tool calls and dropped whitespace-only content, which no chat template can restore, so the whole previous response was prefilled again.

Together with the runtime's GLM chat template (docker-110), a CPU reproduction with the deployed GLM-5.3 tokenizer reuses about 99.7% of the next prompt instead of 79% when the previous answer or reasoning ended in a newline or content preceded a tool call on its own line.
